agreement.text: An NP first practices at least 2,080 hours under a collaborative agreement; since August 1, 2026 that must last at least three years with an APRN collaborator, who may be a physician or an APRN with at least three years of APRN practice. An NP whose first 2,080 hours are in services other than primary care or mental health completes them in a setting where APRNs and physicians work together.
